description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Programmatic access to Kept for apps and AI agents. Authenticate with an API key
(`Authorization: Bearer kept_sk_…`, create one under **Agents & API**) or a browser session.

Money only moves through PayPal: funding uses PayPal Orders v2, releases use PayPal Payouts,
and refunds/splits use PayPal Payments v2 refunds. Every money-moving endpoint is a state-machine
transition and is safe to retry.

Agents may prefer the MCP endpoint at `/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), which wraps the same operations as tools.
